purpose: Read-only front/back reference proportions for whole-body 3D refit; not anatomy ground truth

coordinate_convention.pixels: origin upper left; x right; y down
coordinate_convention.visible_height: visible hair crown to lowest boot sole; not barefoot anatomical height
coordinate_convention.sides: image_left / image_right; not anatomical left / right

method.landmarks: Manual visual estimates on original 1086x1448 images; uncertainty reported per point
method.silhouette: Warm/dark foreground mask: min(R,G,B)<165 OR (R-B>14 AND mean(R,G,B)<225), union of row y-1..y+1; contiguous runs of >=4 pixels
limitations: Hair adds approximately 1-2% of visible height relative to bald skull. Do not blindly enforce hair-crown head length on a bald model.
Clothed knees, hips, crotch and boot ankles are surface/clothing estimates, not skeletal measurements.
Foreground runs at upper-body heights can merge torso and arms. Central torso width is supplied only where runs are separated.
These images are close front/back views but not calibrated orthographic scans. Perspective and relaxed pose affect projected arm widths and segment lengths.
Front/back elbow surface centres differ by roughly 1% height; use a target band, not exact shared joint pixels.
Wrist/foot lateral separation describes reference pose as well as body proportion.

skull_crown_inferred.note: skull hidden by hair; low confidence
